tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Websites are closing their doors to artificial intelligence agents as companies enforce anti-bot rules, raising serious usability concerns. Confirmed by The Verge.
Anthropic prepares to release Claude Fable 5.5 next week, along with other models via early access. Still open, per TestingCatalog AI News.
Steve Eisman warns that OpenAI is now so important that its collapse could cause a recession in the US. Still open, per TradingView.
Eight states sue OpenAI, saying its popular chatbot is hurting children and deceiving adults. Reported by Chattanooga Times Free Press.
An engineer is accused of using artificial intelligence to build a recording device in OpenAI's San Francisco office and now faces federal charge. Reported by Los Angeles Times.
Free every hour.
